description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Buff Holy 20% (15s)], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Warrior of Light (Holy)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Warrior of Light (Holy)
description.text: Increases [Holy Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, instant cast speed for Holy Abilities (max 5 turns), Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Radiant Sword+
description.text: Four single ranged attacks (1.10/1.15 each) after 0-2/3+ uses, grants [Buff Holy 10% (15s)] to all allies every second activation

description.name: Crossover+
description.text: Six single attacks (1.05/1.10 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Buff Holy 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
